Name: Mannequin Marriage
Author: SnowyWithAChanceOfLizards
Description:
The new mannequins are nice and all, but wouldn't it be awesome if you could marry them? Be it for a prank on your friends, or just because you have a weird desire to marry a literal Ken doll, this mod will do it for you.

Version 1.1 is live! You an now officially marry the cursed mannequin!

Current Features:

Custom Dialogue (150+ lines!)
Custom home
Custom area
Complex schedule
Gift likes and dislikes
Holiday dialogue
Custom spouse room and patio
Custom tilesheets


Easter eggs


How to meet Manny:

Enter your home with a Cursed Mannequin to trigger the cut scene, then go to the forest. By the entrance to the Secret Woods is a path leading up and to the right. Enter there, and you'll reach Manny's house!

Want to make it easier to meet Manny? Toggle on "EasyManny" from the Mod Options menu or via the config file. He'll automatically be available, no Cursed Mannequin required!






Planned Features:

Events
Dialogue with townsfolk
